title: Commerce Secretary says US opposes Apple buying Chinese memory chips
summary: However, Apple COO Sabih Khan told the WSJ that while Apple does customize many iPhone components, “there isn’t a lot of customization” when it comes to memory, raising the possibility that Apple could simply use off-the-shelf Chinese memory chips.
